title: sessionBanner now explicitly instructs the model to relay the audit UI URL
body:
Keep the audit UI line an explicit instruction to tell the user the URL, not a neutral status fact. src/hooks/banner.js sessionBanner() was changed from a neutral fact line ('DD - Audit UI: ${url}') to an explicit instruction ('DD - Audit UI: ${url} -- tell the user this URL near the start of your first reply this session, if you have not already'). Reason: SessionStart hook output (both systemMessage and hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext) reaches the model only, never the terminal, on every harness (see hooks/session-start/claude-code-output-model-only and hooks/session-start/claude-code-output-model-only's claude-mem cross-validation) -- so the model choosing to relay the URL in its first chat reply is the only remaining path for the human to see it, and a passive fact line left that relay to the model's unprompted judgment (observed: it did not happen until the user explicitly asked). This is a deliberate exception to the 'advisory content, never a command' framing in CLAUDE.md's non-negotiable properties -- that property concerns retrieved memory/knowledge atoms outranking the host or user, not DD's own operational self-description telling the model how to surface DD's own status, which is closer to MCP server instructions than to injected knowledge. If this pattern is later challenged as violating that property, re-read the distinction before reverting. Applies uniformly across harnesses since buildSessionStartContext/sessionBanner is shared, non-harness-specific code.

Why: User explicitly asked to make the banner wording an explicit instruction ('hacelo que sea explicita') after a multi-turn investigation established that (1) Claude Code suppresses SessionStart systemMessage/additionalContext from the terminal on v2.1.227+, (2) claude-mem's own source uses the identical systemMessage pattern and is equally affected, and (3) the model relaying the banner in its first chat reply is the only viable fallback given DD's plugin constraints (no persistent process guaranteed, no per-harness veto). Implemented as a one-line wording change in sessionBanner(), verified via `node --test tests/hooks/banner.test.js tests/hooks/session-start.test.js tests/stress/plugin-scale.test.js` (20/20 passing, no test changes needed since the existing regex assertions match substrings of the new text).

evidence.summary: sessionBanner(): Changed the audit-UI line from a passive fact to an explicit instruction telling the model to tell the user the URL near the start of its first reply.
20/20 tests passing after the wording change, no test assertions needed updating.

evidence.ref: user turn: "hacelo que sea explicita" following "para todos los harnesses"
evidence.summary: User explicitly directed making the SessionStart banner wording an explicit instruction, applicable to all harnesses, not just Claude Code.
Anchored delivery: keywords validated against this memory's own text and a generic-request corpus before proposing.

issues: archived_by_person: describes the session banner; v2 session start injects nothing

v1.trigger: Editing src/hooks/banner.js sessionBanner(), or wondering why the SessionStart advisory phrases the audit UI line as an imperative instead of a neutral status fact.
